title: Typed Env Config (Zod)
prompt:
Centralize env-var reads behind a single typed object so missing values fail loudly at startup.

**Requirements:**
1. In `env.ts`, import `z` from `zod`.
2. Define `const EnvSchema = z.object({ API_URL: z.string().url(), FEATURE_FLAG_AUTH: z.coerce.boolean().default(false) });`.
3. Define and export `function loadEnv(raw: Record<string, string | undefined>): z.infer<typeof EnvSchema> { return EnvSchema.parse(raw); }`.
4. Define and export `type Env = z.infer<typeof EnvSchema>;`.
hints: Calling `loadEnv(process.env)` once at startup means every component can rely on `Env`'s shape.
Zod's parse throws on missing values -- you'd rather know at boot than after deploy.
